name: Keep resource cleanup bound to its original directories and native descriptor

evidence.observed: The source guard refused an actual post-child library replacement; lease cleanup entered an unbound coordinator path and created directories in the replacement before closing the displaced descriptor.

changes: Capture existing application, coordinator, lease and policy-parent dev/ino identities for the broker lifetime.
Recheck scope before coordinator acquisition, after cancellation callbacks/acquisition, around policy reads and before scoped publication/retirement.
Reuse the pinned NativeLock backend; invalid scope invokes its new PID/RLock-protected descriptor-only close method, without resolving/deleting a replacement path.
Preserve the existing pending CleanupOwner settlement body byte-for-byte; native quiescence still precedes lease release.
Keep the existing reservation try/finally around both admission and work, so scope failure at gate exit after lease publication cannot strand the newly owned descriptor.
Mark a lease released only when its actual lock descriptor is no longer held; retain cleanup_pending and surface ResourceStateError instead of silently adopting the new scope.

exception_contract.message: The selected resource directory changed; reopen the selected library before retrying.
exception_contract.original_error: Preserved through normal cause/context chaining; no blanket suppression.
exception_contract.replacement_paths: Not cleaned, adopted or initialized by the stale broker.
exception_contract.old_metadata: May remain inert at its original owned location after descriptor-only close; an explicitly constructed current broker can handle stale unlocked metadata.

real_service_regression.scope: Actual formatting child, actual root swap/canary/no new replacement files; only exact native Windows5/32 rename refusal may prevent the real swap.

peer_review.scope: Directory authority, descriptor ownership, preserved pending cleanup, real filesystem tests and actual format-child fixture; no execution claim.

unchanged: Public ResourceBroker/ResourceLease constructor and operation signatures
Every existing resource test and native scenario
No global cache, alternate worker, new persistent state or model/device dependency

related_diagnostic_dependency_fix.policy: Separate version-pinned ReportLab4.4.9 test fixture import; all production locks untouched.
